messages.content: Compare two hotels now. I need the real three-person room setup, not a rate that quietly assumes only two guests. Show the full cost under driving first, then tell me what changes under each flight schedule.

I found two workable candidates for June 12-15. Downtown, the Riverfront Plaza has a room with two queen beds at $249 nightly. In the university area, the Schenley House has a king studio with a sofa bed at $209 nightly. The downtown quote carries both a destination charge and expensive parking; the university quote is less clear because its first price display is labeled for two adults. I’ll verify occupancy and bedding before treating either total as valid.
Do that. It’s Marcus and Daniel plus Owen, who will be 12. One room, all three nights.

The Riverfront Plaza room is straightforward: two queen beds, maximum occupancy four, and the quoted rate accepts two adults and one 12-year-old without an added-person charge. The Schenley House booking page initially displays two adults, but its king studio description lists one king plus one full-size sofa bed and a maximum occupancy of four. I am checking whether adding Owen changes the rate or triggers a restriction on use of the sofa bed.
And make sure the sofa bed is actually in that room category, not just somewhere in the hotel.

Confirmed. The exact category is “King Studio with Full Sofa Bed.” The hotel’s occupancy desk confirmed that it can be reserved for two adults and one child age 12, the sofa bed is physically in that studio, and there is no extra-occupant fee. The corrected three-guest quote remains $209 per night. A rollaway is not permitted, but none is needed. The Riverfront Plaza’s exact category remains “Two Queen Guest Room,” also valid for all three travelers.
Give me complete driving totals, including every mandatory hotel charge and parking.

For three nights with the car, Riverfront Plaza is $747 room charge, $104.58 lodging tax, $84.75 destination charge including its tax, and $126 for three nights of self-parking at $42 nightly. Complete hotel cost: $1,062.33. Schenley House is $627 room charge, $87.78 lodging tax, no destination or resort fee, and $72 for three nights of parking at $24 nightly. Complete hotel cost: $786.78. Both totals are for one room occupied by all three of you.
That makes downtown $275.55 more before we account for getting around. Compare Saturday and Sunday transportation.

From Riverfront Plaza, the ballpark is about a 0.4-mile walk, typically 8-10 minutes, so no ride is necessary Saturday. The Carnegie Science Center is about 1.1 miles away: roughly 22-25 minutes walking or 6-10 minutes by rideshare. A Sunday round trip is estimated at $22. That makes the practical downtown lodging-and-local-transport total $1,084.33 under the driving plan.

From Schenley House, allow 18-25 minutes to the ballpark and about $24 each way on Saturday. The Science Center is usually 17-23 minutes away and about $22 each way Sunday. Four rides are estimated at $92 total, making its driving-plan total $878.78.
So the university hotel stays cheaper by about $205 even after four rides?

Yes. The difference is $205.55: $1,084.33 downtown versus $878.78 at Schenley House. Traffic around the Saturday game could raise the university-area rides by roughly $10-$20 in total, but that would not erase the gap. Driving to the ballpark would be less attractive because event parking is likely to cost as much as or more than the rides and would add postgame traffic.
What are the cancellation terms? I don’t want a vague “refundable” label.

Riverfront Plaza can be canceled without penalty through 6:00 p.m. local time on Wednesday, June 10. After that, the penalty is one night’s room and tax plus the first night’s destination charge, currently $312.11. Schenley House can be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. local time on Tuesday, June 9. A later cancellation or no-show is charged one night’s room and tax, currently $238.26. Neither rate requires prepayment; each requires a card guarantee.
Now remove parking and run the three-night flight version. Include airport transportation and the activity rides.

With the Friday-to-Monday flights, Riverfront Plaza drops to $936.33 before transportation because the $126 parking charge disappears. Airport rides are estimated at $42 each way and 25-35 minutes in normal traffic. Adding $84 for the airport and $22 for Sunday’s Science Center round trip gives $1,042.33 for hotel and local ground transportation.

Schenley House drops to $714.78 without parking. Airport rides are about $48 each way and 30-40 minutes. Adding $96 for the airport plus $92 for the ballpark and Science Center rides gives $902.78. It remains cheaper by $139.55 under the three-night flight structure.
And the Thursday flight means four nights, June 11-15. Same rooms if they’re available?

Both room types are available for four nights in the current quote. Riverfront Plaza becomes $996 in room charges, $139.44 in lodging tax, and $113 in destination charges including tax. With no parking, plus $84 for airport rides and $22 for the Science Center rides, the four-night hotel-and-ground total is $1,354.44. Schenley House becomes $836 in room charges and $117.04 in tax. Adding $96 for airport rides and $92 for the activity rides produces $1,141.04. The university option is $213.40 less.
Put the full trip structures next to each other using the transportation figures we already kept.

Driving Friday-Monday: Riverfront Plaza is $1,084.33 for hotel, parking, and local rides; adding the prior $278 driving estimate gives $1,362.33. Schenley House is $878.78 for hotel, parking, and activity rides; with the $278 driving estimate, $1,156.78.

Three-night Friday-Monday flights: add the prior $927 airfare for three. Riverfront Plaza totals $1,969.33 including hotel and estimated ground transportation; Schenley House totals $1,829.78.

Four-night Thursday-Monday flights: add the prior $774 airfare. Riverfront Plaza totals $2,128.44; Schenley House totals $1,915.04. Meals and game or museum admission are excluded from all figures.
Any practical reason to pay more for downtown besides walking to the game? Think about the museum and airport too.

Downtown mainly buys the easy Saturday walk and a shorter airport ride by roughly 5-10 minutes each way. It does not materially improve Sunday: Riverfront Plaza is somewhat closer to the Science Center, but Schenley House’s rides remain direct and under about 25 minutes. The university hotel also gives you the clearly confirmed sofa-bed layout and avoids the mandatory destination charge. Unless avoiding the four activity rides is worth roughly $140-$214 depending on the travel structure, downtown does not justify its higher complete cost.
Narrow it to Schenley House. Keep the two-queen downtown room as the fallback with all of those cancellation and fee details, but don’t reserve anything.

Schenley House is the selected hotel candidate, with nothing reserved. The retained room is the King Studio with Full Sofa Bed, confirmed for Marcus, Daniel, and 12-year-old Owen with no added-person charge. It is $786.78 including taxes and three nights of parking under the lead driving plan, or $878.78 after estimated activity rides. The corresponding full driving trip estimate is $1,156.78. Its free-cancellation deadline is 11:59 p.m. local time June 9; the later penalty is $238.26.

Riverfront Plaza remains the fallback. Its Two Queen Guest Room accommodates all three, costs $1,062.33 including taxes, destination charges, and three nights of parking, or $1,084.33 with the Sunday museum rides. Its free-cancellation deadline is 6:00 p.m. local time June 10; the later penalty is $312.11. Airport rides take about 30-40 minutes from Schenley House and 25-35 minutes from Riverfront Plaza. The flight-based totals remain $1,829.78 versus $1,969.33 for three nights and $1,915.04 versus $2,128.44 for four nights. No hotel, flight, or driving component has been purchased.
